children: The American Petroleum Institute reportedly shows a build of 7.14M barrels of oil in U.S. commercial stockpiles for the week ending September 11, after inventories fell by 300K barrels in the previous week.

Gasoline inventories reportedly show a build of 1.46M barrels for the week, distillate inventories reportedly show a build of 1.61M barrels, and Cushing inventories reportedly show a draw of 246K barrels.
The Energy Information Administration is scheduled to release its weekly U.S. petroleum supply report on Wednesday, with the average of analysts surveyed by

forecasting domestic commercial crude stocks would fall by 1.4M barrels, while gasoline inventories were expected to decline by 800K barrels and distillate inventories were expected to remain unchanged from the previous week.
